description: This file defines the FilesFragment class and related UI components for managing and displaying files within a mobile application. It includes UI setup, file selection, display of file items, and actions for sharing and previewing files.

classes.name: FilesFragment
classes.description: Fragment that displays categorized files, enabling sharing and preview actions, and launching system file picker.

classes.name: FileItemAction
classes.description: Enum representing actions for file items (SHARE, PREVIEW).

classes.name: FileListAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter subclass for displaying a list of FileItem objects with share and preview actions.

classes.name: FileViewHolder
classes.description: RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass holding references to the views for each file item.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FilesFragment.

methods.name: startSystemPickerForShare
methods.description: Launches the system document picker for selecting multiple files for sharing.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy of the fragment, setting up UI components.

methods.name: loadSample
methods.description: Loads sample file items for display; in real implementation, would query device media or files.

methods.name: toFileItem
methods.description: Converts a content Uri to a FileItem object with name and size.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Refreshes the adapter with new list of FileItem objects.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder for file item display, attaching click listeners for actions.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of file items in the list.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds file item data to the view holder's views.
